assignments.description: Sets the output owner and routing reason.
assignments.name: Assign_Routing_Result
assignments.label: Assign Routing Result

Flow.description: Decides who should own a Lead (or an auto-created Opportunity) from a marketing engagement. Called by CampaignMember - On Create - After Save. Order: 1) Account Team (In Platform Demo Request goes to the Account Manager, otherwise the requested rep type, falling back to the other team role); 2) APAC (excluding India) goes to the APAC SDR/AM on the Parent Campaign; 3) letter split on the first letter of the Account name against the Parent Campaign SDR/AM split fields (no match or non-letter goes to rep 1). Returns a blank owner when no active rep is found. Returns the owner and a routing reason; it does not update any records.

formulas.description: Owner from the Account Team. Blank when the Account has no AM or SDR on its team (unassigned Account).
formulas.name: formTeamOwnerId
formulas.expression: IF(AND({!varCampaignType} = "In Platform Demo Request", NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account_Team_AM.UserId}))), {!Get_Account_Team_AM.UserId}, IF({!varRepType} = "AM", BLANKVALUE({!Get_Account_Team_AM.UserId}, {!Get_Account_Team_SDR.UserId}), BLANKVALUE({!Get_Account_Team_SDR.UserId}, {!Get_Account_Team_AM.UserId})))

formulas.description: Routing reason when the owner comes from the Account Team.
formulas.name: formTeamReason
formulas.expression: IF(AND({!varCampaignType} = "In Platform Demo Request", NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account_Team_AM.UserId}))), "Account Team - Account Manager (In Platform Demo Request)", IF({!varRepType} = "AM", IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account_Team_AM.UserId})), "Account Team - Account Manager", "Account Team - SDR (no Account Manager on team)"), IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account_Team_SDR.UserId})), "Account Team - SDR", "Account Team - Account Manager (no SDR on team)")))

formulas.description: True when the individual is from APAC, excluding India: Region is Asia or Oceania, or Country is an APAC country name or ISO code.
formulas.name: formIsAPAC
formulas.expression: AND( NOT(OR(UPPER(TRIM({!varCountry})) = "INDIA", UPPER(TRIM({!varCountry})) = "IN")), OR( {!varRegion} = "Asia", {!varRegion} = "Oceania", AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!varCountry})), CONTAINS("|AUSTRALIA|AU|BANGLADESH|BD|BRUNEI|BN|CAMBODIA|KH|CHINA|CN|FIJI|FJ|HONG KONG|HK|INDONESIA|ID|JAPAN|JP|SOUTH KOREA|KOREA|KOREA, REPUBLIC OF|KR|LAOS|LA|MACAU|MACAO|MO|MALAYSIA|MY|MONGOLIA|MN|MYANMAR|MM|NEPAL|NP|NEW ZEALAND|NZ|PAKISTAN|PK|PAPUA NEW GUINEA|PG|PHILIPPINES|PH|SINGAPORE|SG|SRI LANKA|LK|TAIWAN|TW|THAILAND|TH|VIETNAM|VIET NAM|VN|", "|" & UPPER(TRIM({!varCountry})) & "|")) ) )

formulas.description: APAC specialist from the Parent Campaign for the requested rep type.
formulas.name: formAPACOwnerId

formulas.description: First letter of the Account name (or Company), upper case.
formulas.name: formFirstLetter

formulas.description: Letter-split slot whose comma-separated split list (e.g. M,N,O,P) contains the first letter. No match, a non-letter or a blank name falls back to rep 1, shown as "(default)".
formulas.name: formSplitSlot
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!formFirstLetter}), IF({!varRepType} = "AM", "AM 1 (default)", "SDR 1 (default)"), IF({!varRepType} = "AM", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_Split_1__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_1__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_Split_1__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "AM 1", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_Split_2__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_2__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_Split_2__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "AM 2", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_Split_3__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_3__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.AM_Split_3__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "AM 3", "AM 1 (default)"))), IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_1__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_1__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_1__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "SDR 1", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_2__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_2__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_2__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "SDR 2", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_3__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_3__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_3__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "SDR 3", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_4__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_4__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_4__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "SDR 4", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_5__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_5__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_5__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "SDR 5", IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_6__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_6__c})), CONTAINS("," & SUBSTITUTE(UPPER({!recRoutingCampaign.SDR_Split_6__c}), " ", "") & ",", "," & {!formFirstLetter} & ",")), "SDR 6", "SDR 1 (default)"))))))))

formulas.description: User in the chosen letter-split slot on the Parent Campaign.
formulas.name: formSplitOwnerId

formulas.description: Proposed owner: Account Team, then APAC specialist, then letter split.
formulas.name: formOwnerId

formulas.description: Routing reason for the proposed owner.
formulas.name: formOwnerReason
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!formTeamOwnerId})), {!formTeamReason}, IF(AND({!formIsAPAC}, NOT(ISBLANK({!formAPACOwnerId}))), "APAC specialist " & {!varRepType} & " on Parent Campaign", "Letter split (" & BLANKVALUE({!formFirstLetter}, "blank") & ") - " & {!formSplitSlot} & IF({!formIsAPAC}, " (APAC, but no APAC " & {!varRepType} & " set on Parent Campaign)", "")))

formulas.description: Proposed owner if they are an active user, otherwise blank.
formulas.name: formFinalOwnerId

formulas.description: Routing reason, noting when no active rep was found.
formulas.name: formFinalReason
formulas.expression: LEFT( IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Assigned_User.Id})), {!formOwnerReason}, IF(ISBLANK({!formOwnerId}), "Not routed: Account unassigned and no rep found on Parent Campaign for " & {!formOwnerReason}, "Not routed: rep is inactive - " & {!formOwnerReason})), 255)
